Formal subject it · 阶段复盘: it acts as formal subject, replacing the real subject (infinitive or clause) placed later.本课为阶段复盘练习,核心:It is + adjective/noun + to do / that clause。
It is important to learn English.|It takes time to master a skill.|It is said that... reportedly|It is + adjective + for sb to do|It is kind of sb to do (evaluating a person's character uses of)
It is important to keep a diary in English.

# title: It is important _____ a diary in English.
column4: 考查It is + adjective/noun + to do / that clause。此处应为 to keep。句意:用英语写日记很重要。
